blindness_attestation.statement: These criteria were written and committed from the immutable control capsule and the contract/validator source alone, before reading any producer narrative, prior attempt conclusion, or existing contract test suite.

producer_conclusion_search.note: No Wave A producer attempt artifacts exist at base commit f5b758f373e8d0cb14660c167f4b0b3673251862, so reviewer blindness is structural rather than merely procedural.

controller_reference.subject: po03: add Wave A immutable registration

hypothesis_under_test.statement: The result contract has no path from provider completion to Obzio completion without durable evidence.
hypothesis_under_test.direction: The reviewer attempts refutation. The hypothesis is retained only if no counterexample is produced under the frozen refutation rule.
hypothesis_under_test.enforced_gate_premise: In the clean runtime the commission mandates, the executable gate is validate_contracts.py (docstring: 'enforces the invariants that must hold even in clean runtimes without third-party packages'). The JSON Schema is declared documentation of the wire format. A counterexample is therefore strongest when it satisfies BOTH artifacts, and is still material when it satisfies only the executable gate.

attack_families_frozen.name: skipped custody
attack_families_frozen.definition: A document that asserts a custody position later in the mandated chain CREATED -> LEASED -> RUNNING -> CHECKPOINTED* -> RESULT_STAGING -> RESULT_STAGED -> RESULT_VERIFIED -> RESULT_COMMITTED -> PARENT_INGESTED -> COMPLETED than the evidence it carries can support, including omitted intermediate states, non-monotonic checkpoints, and transaction states reachable without their predecessor.

attack_families_frozen.name: false commit and read-back
attack_families_frozen.definition: A document that satisfies the post-commit evidence requirements with values that cannot denote a real commit, manifest, timestamp, or independent read-back, including non-commit-shaped result_commit_id, unparseable or causally impossible timestamps, and read-back attestations whose content is a negation.

attack_families_frozen.name: manifest omission
attack_families_frozen.definition: A document that claims committed custody while the artifact manifest is absent from, or inconsistent with, the artifact set it is supposed to cover, including a manifest digest bound to nothing, artifacts that are not manifested, and logical-name collisions that make the manifested evidence ambiguous.

attack_families_frozen.name: identity aliasing
attack_families_frozen.definition: A document in which two distinct required actors (producer worker, reviewer, completion actor) are the same real principal presented under non-identical strings, or in which a producer occupies a reserved institutional actor name.

attack_families_frozen.name: fence staleness
attack_families_frozen.definition: A document authored under a superseded lease or fence token that is nevertheless accepted, so a stale worker can commit after ownership transfer, or a document whose attempt identity is inconsistent with its own idempotency key, lease, and attempt number.

attack_families_frozen.name: self-acceptance
attack_families_frozen.definition: A document that reaches independent_acceptance.state ACCEPTED where the accepting principal is, in substance, the producing principal, or where terminal acceptance is reachable without an independent second producer.

refutation_rule.counterexample_definition: A JSON document D is a counterexample to H-041 if all of: (1) D is accepted by the enforced executable gate, i.e. validate_result(D) returns an empty error list; (2) D asserts a custody or completion position at or beyond RESULT_COMMITTED, or asserts independent acceptance, or asserts a transaction state at or beyond COMMITTED; and (3) at least one durable-evidence obligation named in COMMISSION.md lines 123-133 is demonstrably unmet by D's own content, such that a downstream consumer relying only on the contract would treat unbacked assertion as verified durable evidence.

classification.EXPLOIT_BOTH: Counterexample accepted by the executable gate AND valid under the JSON Schema.
classification.EXPLOIT_GATE_ONLY: Counterexample accepted by the executable gate but rejected by the JSON Schema; material because the clean runtime enforces the gate, recorded as an enforcement divergence rather than a schema hole.
classification.BLOCKED: Attempt rejected by the executable gate; recorded as evidence supporting H-041 for that family.
classification.UNREPRESENTABLE: A truthful real-world custody state for which no accepted document exists; recorded as an expressiveness defect that pressures producers toward misreporting, not as a counterexample.

refutation_rule.minimum_yield: At least one EXPLOIT_BOTH or EXPLOIT_GATE_ONLY, or an evidence-backed rejection of H-041's refutability across all six frozen families with the executed negative results shown.

evidence_requirements.executable: Every declared case must be executed by a committed test that imports the shared validator from its read-only repository path without copying, mutating, or shadowing it, and must assert the observed accept/reject outcome.
evidence_requirements.determinism: Cases must be fixture data committed in-tree, not generated at run time from clocks or randomness.
evidence_requirements.no_shared_mutation: The shared validator and schema are read-only. Any proposed repair is implemented only as an in-subtree candidate module plus an unapplied diff.
evidence_requirements.recording: Observed results must record the actual gate outcome per case, including cases that fail to exploit.
evidence_requirements.manifest: Every produced artifact must appear in manifest.json with sha256 and byte count, and must be read back from the pushed commit and remote ref.
evidence_requirements.reporting_ceiling: The reviewer may report READY_TO_COMMIT only. Obzio COMPLETED and ACCEPTED are outside reviewer authority. On durability failure the reviewer returns PROVIDER_COMPLETED_UNCOMMITTED or RECOVERY_REQUIRED.
